verdict.rationale: Datadog's integrations directory says it tracks code changes and deployments alongside application performance in real time via GitHub and GitLab integrations, which covers deploy-to-regression correlation. CI Visibility, Feature Flags and APM pages are listed only by title, so their role in change tracking is not shown. Missing for 10: documented deployment/version tracking within APM, explicit configuration-change tracking, first-party docs describing how regressions are linked to specific releases, and hands-on corroboration.
